grammar.pattern: 需要 + 名词 / 动词短语
grammar.purpose: State a need without turning it into consent
grammar.explanation: 活动需要两个人 states a staffing need; 我需要休息 states a personal need. 需要 is not a volunteer’s promise. 不需要 contrasts absence of need with 不愿意, lack of willingness. Questions like 需要我帮忙吗？ offer help and still await an answer. State quantity and task scope, not a blanket requirement to obey.

examples.py: huó dòng xū yào liǎng gè rén .
xū yào wǒ bān yǐ zi ma ?
examples.en: Do you need me to move chairs?

examples.py: wǒ xū yào xiān kàn rèn wù nèi róng .
examples.en: I need to see the task description first.

commonMistakes.wrong: 需要两个人，所以你已经答应了。
commonMistakes.right: 需要两个人，还要问你愿不愿意。
commonMistakes.why: A need does not establish another person’s agreement.

grammar.pattern: 各 / 各位 / 各种 / 每 / 任何
grammar.purpose: Read distribution and the bounds of a general claim
grammar.explanation: 各组 distributes work by group; 每个人 by individual. 各位 politely addresses those present, not the whole world. 各种 names different kinds, not necessarily every possible type. 任何人都可以询问 uses any within the stated context; 任何人都不 may deny permission to everyone in that context. Always recover what set the statement concerns.

examples.py: gè zǔ xiān què rèn shí jiān .
examples.en: Each group confirms the time first.

examples.py: měi wèi duì yuán bān liǎng bǎ yǐ zi .
examples.en: Each team member moves two chairs.

examples.zh: 任何人都可以先问内容。
examples.py: rèn hé rén dōu kě yǐ xiān wèn nèi róng .
examples.en: Anyone may first ask about the task.

commonMistakes.wrong: 每组两个人，就是每个人两组。
commonMistakes.right: 每组两个人，是一组有两个人。
commonMistakes.why: Do not reverse the distributed unit and the counted members.

dialogue.title: A need is not a promise
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find the volunteer’s actual availability and task.

lines.zh: 周末需要两位志愿者，你愿意吗？
lines.py: zhōu mò xū yào liǎng wèi zhì yuàn zhě , nǐ yuàn yì ma ?
lines.en: Two volunteers are needed this weekend; are you willing?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我支持活动，但只能来一小时。
lines.py: wǒ zhī chí huó dòng , dàn zhǐ néng lái yī xiǎo shí .
lines.en: I support the event but can come for only one hour.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 可以，先把责任说清楚。
lines.py: kě yǐ , xiān bǎ zé rèn shuō qīng chǔ .
lines.en: That is fine; clarify responsibilities first.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 各组怎么分配任务？
lines.py: gè zǔ zěn me fēn pèi rèn wù ?
lines.en: How are tasks allocated to each group?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 每组两个人，你负责名单，另一位负责入口。
lines.py: měi zǔ liǎng gè rén , nǐ fù zé míng dān , lìng yī wèi fù zé rù kǒu .
lines.en: Two per group: you handle the list and the other person the entrance.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 共同任务需要搬椅子吗？
lines.py: gòng tóng rèn wù xū yào bān yǐ zi ma ?
lines.en: Does the shared task require moving chairs?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 只搬四把。我们共有四把，不是全楼的椅子。
lines.py: zhǐ bān sì bǎ . wǒ men gòng yǒu sì bǎ , bù shì quán lóu de yǐ zi .
lines.en: Only four. We have four in total, not all the building’s chairs.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，一小时后我要走，别把支持写成全天答应。
lines.py: hǎo , yī xiǎo shí hòu wǒ yào zǒu , bié bǎ zhī chí xiě chéng quán tiān dā yìng .
lines.en: Okay; I leave after one hour, so do not record support as all-day agreement.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 活动需要两位志愿者，招募先说明工作内容。

lines.py: zhì yuàn zhě biǎo shì zì yuàn , bù néng yóu bié ren tì tā dā yìng .
lines.en: Volunteers express voluntary consent; others cannot agree for them.

lines.zh: 每组两个人，各组先确认时间。
lines.py: měi zǔ liǎng gè rén , gè zǔ xiān què rèn shí jiān .
lines.en: Two people per group; each group confirms the time first.

lines.py: yī wèi fù zé míng dān , lìng yī wèi fù zé rù kǒu .
lines.en: One handles the list and the other the entrance.

lines.zh: 积极支持也可以有时间限制，不是没有责任。

lines.zh: 合作把任务分开，也把每个人的同意记清楚。
lines.py: hé zuò bǎ rèn wù fēn kāi , yě bǎ měi gè rén de tóng yì jì qīng chǔ .
lines.en: Cooperation divides tasks and records each person’s agreement clearly.
